improve.title: Defensive work rate
tips: Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost.
When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.
Know your runner before the cross comes in. A quick look over the shoulder saves a goal.
improve.coach: Shrinking from 67% to 40%. Love the trend.

improve.title: On-ball involvement
tips: Check away, then check back. A two-yard feint buys you the space to receive.
Play with your head up between touches. You can't find a pass you never looked for.
Talk. Call for it early so the passer knows where you'll be.
improve.coach: It's come up in 33% of your matches, but only 20% lately. You're winning this one.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Every team needs someone who smells goals. You've got the nose. 42% of matches. That's not luck; that's who you are.

coach.intro: buddskees, 12 matches is enough to see who you are as a player. I like what I see, and I see where we can go.
coach.name: Coach Lasso
